title: eMudhra intermediate CA private key compromise

untrustedRoots.subject: /C=IN/OU=emSign PKI/O=eMudhra Technologies Limited/CN=emSign ECC Root CA - G3

advice: OS/browser revocation, PEM bundles and runtime CA stores are independent; update each consumer.

Rust: inspect each Cargo.lock for rustls-webpki 0.103.16 or later and webpki-roots/webpki-root-certs 1.0.11 or later (1.0.10 removed emSign ECC Root CA - G3; 1.0.11 also removed emSign Root CA - C1 and emSign ECC Root CA - C3), or a documented backport; rustc alone is not evidence.
macOS 27.2.1, 26.7.3 and 15.8.3 block the 12 certificates in the command-line tools and remove the two roots from /etc/ssl/cert.pem (Apple, 2026-11-09): update macOS before editing the OS bundle.

Windows CPython takes trust anchors from the ROOT store and ignores the CTL; CPython 3.11.18, 3.12.16, 3.13.18, 3.14.10 and 3.15.2 (2026-10-25) carry the fix (gh-160040): update every Python, including the ones uv manages.
